data.name: Wyrdbonds
data.detailed_description:
Enter the world of Therris, a vast realm where magic flows through the land and mythical creatures known as Wyrd roam free. In this online multiplayer adventure, you’ll harness spells and strategy to capture, train, and bond with Wyrd as you embark on a journey filled with discovery, danger, and friendship.

At its heart, this is a creature capture monster tamer MMO. But Therris is more than battles—it’s a living, breathing world built for exploration and community. Whether you set out alone or travel alongside friends, you’ll uncover diverse regions, challenge dangerous foes, and forge your own path in a constantly expanding adventure.

Every Wyrd is unique, possessing distinct traits, powers, and personalities. Mastering their abilities and creating synergized teams is the key to success, whether you’re fighting rival adventurers, taking on world events, or delving into hidden mysteries.

But life in Therris extends far beyond combat. Players can:

  • Research strange magical phenomena and uncover the origins of Wyrd

  • Cook meals to strengthen their companions or share with allies

  • Craft gear and items to aid in exploration

  • Trade resources, knowledge, and creatures with other players

Your story in Therris is shaped not just by your actions, but by the community around you. With a strong focus on cooperation, the game encourages adventurers to work together—whether that’s taking down towering world bosses, building up settlements, or discovering entirely new species of Wyrd.

The world of Therris is never static. New regions, challenges, and Wyrd are constantly waiting to be discovered, ensuring that every journey feels fresh and rewarding. Together with other players, you’ll help shape the future of the world itself.



Master both styles of battling whether you're fighting wild creatures in the over world with the real time battling mechanics or entering battles with your friends and NPC's in the turn based 1v1 battling mechanic.

Key Features

  • Capture and train a wide variety of magical creatures called Wyrd

  • Explore the living world of Therris, rich with lore and secrets

  • Battle using real-time & turn-based strategies

  • Cook, craft, trade, and research to support your adventure

  • Play solo or with friends in a constantly growing MMO

Embark on your journey. Master your magic. Bond with Wyrd.
The world of Therris awaits.

data.short_description: Travel across Therris in this MMO Creature Capture Monster Tamer game. Use your Arcaband and Wyrdtome to capture, summon and train Wyrds to use within the world to explore, battle and more all with your friends by your side. Will you rise to the top and become the best summoner in Therris?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: NA
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: NA
